name: Cornas

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Syrah sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

notes: Cornas is made only from Syrah, and its wines are almost black in color and age well.

blurb.text: Cornas makes only red wine, made only from Syrah.
